title: My Home — There is / There are

expressions.example: Come in, make yourself at home! There's coffee in the kitchen.
After the long trip — home sweet home!

expressions.meaning: Não há lugar como o lar.
expressions.example: I love traveling but there's no place like home.
We moved in last week — let's have a housewarming party!

sentences: There is a sofa in the living room.
There are two bedrooms in my apartment.
There is a big fridge in the kitchen.
There are no curtains in the bedroom.
There was a garden when I was a child.
There were three chairs around the table.
Is there a microwave in the kitchen?
Are there any windows in the bathroom?

grammar.title: There is / There are / There was / There were
rules: There is → singular (presente): "There is a sofa in the living room."
There was → singular (passado): "There was a lamp here."
There were → plural (passado): "There were books on the shelf."

quiz.q: ___ a sofa in the living room.
___ a garden when I was a child.
There ___ a fridge in the kitchen. (negative, present)

speak: There is a sofa in my living room.
There was a lamp here before.
